Every AI budget review I sat in this year had the same slide, and nobody could say who read the output.

Ours had it too. Line 14: an agent that summarises support tickets. Cost: 900 a month. Readers: the agent, and a dashboard nobody opened since May.

So we switched it off for two weeks to see who noticed.

Support noticed on day nine. Not because the summaries stopped. Because the dashboard turned grey and someone thought the database was down.

We kept the agent off. We kept the dashboard, grey.

Turns out the 900 a month was buying a colour.
